continuity_scope: Attack on Titan, Volume 1, Kodansha USA English print edition (19 June 2012; ISBN 9781612620244; 208 pages). This is a narrow English manga-volume metadata pass; its digital edition (16 July 2013; ISBN 9781612626154), Japanese Kodansha Volume 1, anime, films, games, guidebooks, later volumes, and adaptations are separate witnesses.
work_or_witnesses: Attack on Titan, Volume 1, Kodansha USA English print edition (2012)
Kodansha USA official Volume 1 product/reader page
official adaptation/game metadata as boundary only
coverage_rule: Include only named individual dramatic characters directly named by selected Kodansha USA Volume 1 metadata. It names none. Titans, walls, city, military/political concepts, equipment, transformations, and themes remain terms; no character or relationship is inferred from untranscribed manga pages.
omissions: All named characters, families, military roles/factions, Titans as individual beings, equipment, transformations, and places are omitted because the selected English metadata does not name them.
Later identity/political revelations, anime, films, games, guidebooks, later volumes, Japanese wording, and adaptations are separate witnesses.
War, fascism, and genocide analogies are not projected from this opening witness. It establishes fictional threatened humanity and Titans only.
Child/family loss, extreme violence, body horror, deaths, and grief are not expanded beyond the publisher's violent/mature-content warnings and threat premise.
uncertainties: The official product page has a reader but browser-readable text offers no chapter/panel locator, so this is metadata-only.
Kodansha says Titans kill humans and humanity hides behind walls, but does not identify individuals, causes, politics, Titan origins, or later revelations.
Violence/body-horror and mature-content cautions are supported by the premise/warning; family/child loss, fascism/genocide readings, and outcomes require separately inspected text.
evidence_basis: Kodansha first-party English Volume 1 product metadata only; no fan wiki, Wikipedia, adaptation recap, game source, or uninspected manga panel is used.
